videos.title: What to know about McDonald's federal lawsuit over AI
videos.focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
videos.summary: ABC News legal contributor Brian Buckmire outlines allegations in a federal lawsuit involving McDonald’s and AI, while food-industry analyst Phil Lempert discusses how technology is changing dining. The concise segment is useful as a current issue map, not as legal advice or independent verification of disputed claims. podcasts.title: JB Pritzker thinks AI could help us live to 100 — or threaten us like nukes
podcasts.source: Decoder with Nilay Patel — The Verge
podcasts.summary: Nilay Patel interviews Illinois Governor JB Pritzker about AI, privacy, data centers, regulation and government’s role in collective-action problems. The conversation is useful for comparing state experimentation with demands for federal rules, while separating a policymaker’s positions from empirical evidence. The Verge page and Apple’s current episode listing establish identity and date; Apple reports 59 minutes. Audio was not played.
podcasts.why_it_matters: Use the interview to frame policy questions about privacy, infrastructure and accountability, then verify concrete statutory claims in official Illinois and federal sources.

podcasts.title: Talking with the dead
podcasts.summary: Vox’s Unexplainable examines “deadbots,” AI replicas built from a deceased person’s messages or voice, with Cambridge researchers Katarzyna Nowaczyk-Basińska and Tomasz Hollanek plus psycholinguist Julie Sedivy. The discussion surfaces consent, grief, detachment and commercialization questions without presenting simulation as resurrection. Vox supplies the episode context and transcript access; Apple confirms a 36-minute runtime. Audio was not played.
podcasts.why_it_matters: Before building a memorial chatbot, define consent, data rights, commercialization limits, exit mechanisms and human support, recognizing that technical fidelity cannot resolve grief ethics.

verification.method: Vox identifies the October 17 Unexplainable episode and guests; Apple lists the episode at 36 minutes.
verification.verification_scope: Episode identity, program, date, guests and runtime were verified from Vox and Apple text listings. Audio playback is not claimed.
